purpose: Defines the state models and permitted transitions for ToC publication, ToC build runs, and DLID embedding runs, as the normative table that scripts enforce.
summary: Separates published ToC state from build run progress; stale and missing-reference are judgments, not states
States that search, DLID resolution and checks hold no state and change no managed state
Transition table P-01 to P-03 for confirmed ToC: unbuilt, published, failure keeps prior state
Build run transitions B-01 to B-09 from start through scope, IDs, changes, info, reference check, candidate, finish or fail
Failure reports the failed document, field and reason, never retries automatically, and keeps the old confirmed ToC
Document info already confirmed is not rolled back when a build fails
Reference check results: match, path mismatch, or missing in specified directory, with directory and time
DLID embedding run transitions E-01 to E-07 including duplicate original confirmation and failure handling
Mermaid state diagrams visualize the tables; combinations absent from the tables are rejected
tasks: Implementing ToC build or rebuild scripts
Designing error reporting for build failures
Checking whether a transition is permitted
title: DES-004 状態モデルと許可遷移
